data.narrative:
SpaceX is a pre-IPO Space & Aerospace company that has raised $86 billion to date and carries a current valuation of $1.65 trillion. The comparable universe in Space & Aerospace comprises 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers, including Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, Planet Labs, and Impulse Space.

Standard valuation triangulation methods are not applicable to this target. Peer-median analysis cannot be deployed because no same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables exist within the narrower Space & Aerospace peer set—while 13 same-sector peers exist broadly, fewer than 3 meet the filtering criteria required for statistical reliability. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples also cannot be applied; the sector median P/S across the 6 public tickers stands at 27.4x, but SpaceX's revenue is not disclosed, which prevents multiplication-based valuation.

Without disclosed financials or sufficient stage-matched peers, this analysis cannot support a quantitative valuation range. The $1.65 trillion mark reflects market consensus at announcement; validation would require either publication of SpaceX's historical or forward revenue, or identification of additional private peers at comparable scale and maturity. Key uncertainties center on revenue scale, profitability trajectory, and whether public-market multiples for smaller Space & Aerospace operators remain appropriate anchors for a company of SpaceX's stage and scope.
